content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Secretary-General position at the International Telecommunication Union. Tell about your experience in telecommunications policy, the digital divide, and technology development. Describe your vision for the ITU's role in building the digital society and regulating artificial intelligence. Length about 450 words.
